notes_unverified: Full combo-part catalogue (every body/tires/glider/character with individual stat values) not enumerated here — too large for this pass; only category structure captured. Would need a dedicated fetch of a stats site (e.g. mk8dx-lounge.com or a dedicated MK8DX stats wiki page) to fill in.
v4.0.0 change list captured from patch-note aggregator articles, not Nintendo's own official patch notes page verbatim; cross-check against nintendo.com support page before treating as exhaustive.

v4_0_0_changes.headline: Switch 2 enhancement update (free), not a paid Switch 2 Edition
switch2_only: Higher-resolution display support for Switch 2 / high-res TVs
Local multiplayer expanded from 1-4 to 5-8 players (needs at least one Joy-Con 2 or Switch 2 Pro Controller for 8-player)
CameraPlay support (USB camera for local multiplayer face-cam, and via GameChat online with Switch Online)
all_platforms: New '96 Races' VS Race mode for Booster Course Pass owners: races through all 96 tracks in a single marathon session (previous VS Race cap was 48 races in a row)
Speed increase on original Switch hardware (~1 coin's worth of extra speed)
Driving speed / Boo item adjustments, including an off-road improvement for Boo

combo_part_categories.description: Every driver in MK8DX has base stats; equipping a Body (kart/bike), Tires, and Glider modifies six stat axes: Speed (Ground/Water/Air/Anti-Gravity), Acceleration, Weight, Handling (Ground/Water/Air/Anti-Gravity), Traction, and Mini-Turbo.
combo_part_categories.note: Full enumerated stat tables for all characters/bodies/tires/gliders not captured in this pass due to size; competitive players typically reference a small set of 'meta' combos (e.g. heavyweight + Roller/Slim tires + high-speed body) rather than the full matrix. Recommend a follow-up fetch of a dedicated stats resource if the records app needs exact stat numbers.
